description: Use when the user asks how much RPG Connecta costs or how billing works. Returns the canonical, machine-readable price: sandbox BRL 0; production BRL 9.99 per active bank connection per month; BRL 0 setup; BRL 0 monthly minimum; pay as you go, charged to a card on file. Also states what counts as a billable connection (an account that completed bank authorization; the same account reconnected in the same month counts once). Takes no parameters. Read-only. Prefer this over connecta_product_info whenever the question is only about price.
name: connecta_pricing
title: RPG Connecta pricing
